rule:
Block L loop classification with the K3.25 audit's U5 correction applied from the start (declared before any
K4 Block L request). Runs after the frozen analyzer (K3.25 stage0/drivers/analyze_l.py, unchanged) and adds fields;
it never edits that analyzer's output.

Why: on K3.25 the analyzer's R50 rule counted an answer that re-states code drafted in the reasoning as a terminal
loop (6 of 8 L3 code flags; earlier 50-gram occurrences were all in the reasoning, exact period None).
Per reply (re-tokenized with the K3.25/K4 tokenizer, byte-identical, add_special_tokens=False):
  content_R50_final   R50 computed on the content tokens alone, an earlier occurrence counted only inside the
                      content (window 4,096, 50-grams); None when the content is shorter than 4,146 tokens.
  copy_share          share of content 50-grams that also occur in the reasoning.
  category            "terminal loop"             analyzer onset set AND an exact period (m >= 0.8) post onset;
                      "content self-repetition"   content_R50_final >= 0.5 without an exact period;
                      "copy from reasoning"       analyzer onset set, no exact period, content_R50_final < 0.5
                                                  (or not assessable) and copy_share >= 0.3;
                      "none"                      otherwise; "flag without period" for an onset outside these.
Host mode runs itself in a --network none, CPU-only container of the CuteAFD image (tokenizers, numpy), as
analyze_l.py does; receipts are mounted read-only.

  loop_rules.py --analysis l/ANALYSIS.json --out l/LOOP-RULES.json      (host; needs docker, no GPU)
